column3: “A yoke out of leather straps” combines bands and yoke-bars and specifies leather.
“Send word” replaces sending the objects themselves; sons of Ammon is rendered Ammon.
The repeated instruction “Thus you shall say to your masters” is compressed.
“To whom I please” renders what is right in My eyes.
“Under the authority” renders into the hand.
“Must not serve” makes the prediction of non-service into a prohibition.
“Again” is supplied in attending to them.
